name: Database Inspector
description: Read PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite metadata. When the client binary is missing on the host, PostgreSQL and MySQL are queried inside their Docker containers.
author: VibeShell

actions.name: PostgreSQL databases
actions.description: List non-template PostgreSQL databases. Uses the host psql client, or a Docker postgres container when psql is absent.
args: c="$0"; u="$1"; shift; [ -n "$u" ] || u=postgres; if [ -n "$c" ]; then exec docker exec -i "$c" psql -U "$u" "$@"; fi; if command -v psql >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec psql "$@"; fi; c=$(docker ps --format "{{.Names}}" 2>/dev/null | grep -i postgres | head -n 1); [ -n "$c" ] && exec docker exec -i "$c" psql -U "$u" "$@"; echo "psql not found and no postgres container detected" >&2; exit 127
SELECT datname FROM pg_database WHERE NOT datistemplate ORDER BY datname;

actions.name: PostgreSQL tables
actions.description: List user tables in a PostgreSQL database. Uses the host psql client, or a Docker postgres container when psql is absent.
args: c="$0"; u="$1"; shift; [ -n "$u" ] || u=postgres; if [ -n "$c" ]; then exec docker exec -i "$c" psql -U "$u" "$@"; fi; if command -v psql >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec psql "$@"; fi; c=$(docker ps --format "{{.Names}}" 2>/dev/null | grep -i postgres | head -n 1); [ -n "$c" ] && exec docker exec -i "$c" psql -U "$u" "$@"; echo "psql not found and no postgres container detected" >&2; exit 127
SELECT schemaname || '.' || tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') ORDER BY 1;

actions.name: PostgreSQL query
actions.description: Run one SQL statement using the remote psql authentication context, or inside a Docker postgres container.
args: c="$0"; u="$1"; shift; [ -n "$u" ] || u=postgres; if [ -n "$c" ]; then exec docker exec -i "$c" psql -U "$u" "$@"; fi; if command -v psql >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec psql "$@"; fi; c=$(docker ps --format "{{.Names}}" 2>/dev/null | grep -i postgres | head -n 1); [ -n "$c" ] && exec docker exec -i "$c" psql -U "$u" "$@"; echo "psql not found and no postgres container detected" >&2; exit 127

actions.name: MySQL databases
actions.description: List databases visible to the configured MySQL client. Uses the host mysql client, or a Docker mysql/mariadb container when it is absent.
args: c="$0"; u="$1"; shift; [ -n "$u" ] || u=root; if [ -n "$c" ]; then exec docker exec -i "$c" mysql -u "$u" "$@"; fi; if command -v mysql >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec mysql "$@"; fi; c=$(docker ps --format "{{.Names}}" 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "mysql|mariadb" | head -n 1); [ -n "$c" ] && exec docker exec -i "$c" mysql -u "$u" "$@"; echo "mysql not found and no mysql or mariadb container detected" >&2; exit 127

actions.description: List tables in a MySQL database. Uses the host mysql client, or a Docker mysql/mariadb container when it is absent.

actions.name: SQLite files
actions.description: Find common SQLite database files below the remote login directory.

actions.name: SQLite query
actions.description: Open a SQLite file and run one SQL statement.
